q: When a force is applied to an object, it can turn the object about a certain point known as the pivot(or) the ____.
e: When a force is applied to an object, it can turn the object about a certain point known as the pivot(or) the fulcrum. The name used here is fulcrum.

q: The turning effect of a force about a particular fulcrum is measured by the ____ of that force (or) torque.
e: Torque is r × F, a cross product, so it is a vector. The turning effect of a force about a particular fulcrum is measured by the moment of that force (or) torque.

q: Torque is a ____ quantity and its vector form can be expressed as the Eq.(2.5), $\tau = r \times F$.
e: Torque is r × F, a cross product, so it is a vector. Torque is a vector quantity and its vector form can be expressed as the Eq.(2.5), tau = r × F.

q: The magnitude of the moment of force (or) torque $\tau$ is defined as the product of the force F and the ____ from the line of action of the force to the fulcrum.
e: Torque is r × F, a cross product, so it is a vector. The magnitude of the moment of force (or) torque tau is defined as the product of the force F and the perpendicular distance from the line of action of the force to the fulcrum.

q: The equation for the magnitude of torque can be written as $\tau = Fr \sin \theta =$ ____.
e: Torque is r × F, a cross product, so it is a vector. The equation for the magnitude of torque can be written as tau = Fr sin θ = Fd.

q: The perpendicular distance from the line of action of the force to the fulcrum ($d = r \sin \theta$) is also called the ____ of a force.
e: The perpendicular distance from the line of action of the force to the fulcrum (d = r sin θ) is also called the moment arm of a force. The name used here is moment arm.

q: The ____ of a force is a line along which a force is considered to act.
e: The line of action of a force is a line along which a force is considered to act. Line of action is what this statement is using.

q: In SI units, the moment of force (or) torque is measured in newton metre (N m), which is never written as ____.
e: Torque is r × F, a cross product, so it is a vector. In SI units, the moment of force (or) torque is measured in newton metre (N m), which is never written as joule.
